preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100000.
Each test case must have n, a, and b as positive integers within the range of 1 to 10^9.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case must be either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: any(n == 1 or (n % a == 0 and (n // a) in set) or (n - b) in set for n in test_cases)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output 'Yes' indicates that n is in the generated set, and 'No' indicates it is not.
